  • Method Details

    • take

      public static boolean take(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, int capacityUnits, ProtectionContext context)
      Moves one powder-snow block from a full powder-snow cauldron at pos into stack, leaving an empty cauldron.

      On the server it debits the cauldron, credits the bucket, awards the cauldron-use and item-use stats, fires the filled-bucket criterion for a player, and emits GameEvent.FLUID_PICKUP; the fill sound plays on both sides.

      Parameters:
      level - acting level
      pos - cauldron position
      face - face to authorize against
      stack - bucket stack, credited one unit on success
      capacityUnits - the bucket tier's powder-snow capacity
      context - authorization identity
      Returns:
      true when the transfer ran; false without mutation unless the cauldron is full, the bucket is empty or already in powder-snow mode below capacityUnits, and protection allows the interaction

    • place

      public static boolean place(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context)
      Moves one powder-snow block from stack into an empty cauldron at pos, filling it to a full powder-snow cauldron.

      On the server it debits the bucket, sets the cauldron, awards the cauldron-use and item-use stats, and emits GameEvent.FLUID_PLACE; the empty sound plays on both sides.

      Parameters:
      level - acting level
      pos - cauldron position
      face - face to authorize against
      stack - bucket stack, debited one unit on success
      context - authorization identity
      Returns:
      true when the transfer ran; false without mutation unless the target is an empty cauldron, the bucket is in powder-snow mode with at least one block, and protection allows the interaction
